text:
rachel (design): quick Q — compact spend rows are great but customers want a low-friction way to peek token splits without navigating away. thinking: small "peek" affordance inside the token cell that surfaces a slim 3-line ledger on hover/click. works both at org and project scope.
noah (frontend): agree. perf note: we must avoid adding heavy DOM for 500 rows. plan: placeholder shell in DOM, lazy-hydrate content (svg/canvas) only after interaction and a short delay.
dina (pm): let's AB test two UX patterns: (A) hover/keyboard peek, (B) explicit "Peek" button inside the cell. measure accidental opens and conversion to invoice.
omar (infra): backend guardrail: don't let previews become a DDoS vector. add per-user LRU cache (TTL 4m), server-side batching for multi-row requests, and request debouncing on client (200ms). also add a global rate cap per user.
sol (data): events to log: `billing.peek.opened`, `billing.peek.method` (hover|button|keyboard), `billing.peek.to_invoice_click`, `billing.peek.visible_ms`. we'll include scope (org|project) + row_id.
rachel (design): copy: preview header = "Token breakdown — last 30 days". inline peek should not show invoice download CTA; only show "View invoice" in the full drawer. button label = "Peek" (short).
noah (frontend): keyboard a11y: preview must be reachable via Tab. include a small `<button class="peek-toggle">` with `aria-controls` -> preview id and `aria-expanded` toggled. If opened inline, don't trap focus; if they open the full drawer, trap. Esc closes and returns focus to the toggle.
dina (pm): experiment details: randomize at user level. primary metric: invoice_click_rate conditioned on peek_open. secondary: preview_qps and accidental_open_rate.
omar (infra): implementation note: endpoint `/billing/preview?rows=[...]` accepts batched ids and returns compact payloads. please only request details for rows in viewport and debounce rapid hovers.
noah (frontend): visual constraints: overlay or popover must not change row height. animate opacity/translate 110ms, respect `prefers-reduced-motion`. contrast for numbers >= 4.5:1.
sol (data): can we also get preview_dwell distribution? want to detect if peek is serving as replacement for full invoice UX.
rachel (design): small microcopy nit: use plural `Tokens` in header. e.g., "Tokens — last 30 days". keep label consistent across org/project.
noah (frontend): dev estimate: 3 days (peek-shell, lazy-load, batched fetch client, analytics hook, feature flag).
omar (infra): infra estimate: 1 day to add LRU cache + batching + rate limits. will add `billing.peek.view` metric tag for method.
dina (pm): action items: rachel update Figma with both patterns, noah open feature branch behind flag, omar add server guards, sol add analytics schema and experiment buckets. we'll roll out to 5% then ramp after qps & accessibility checks.
aria-bot: :white_check_mark: staging smoke succeeded 2026-03-26T09:40Z — preview-shell basic render test passed
noah (frontend): accessibility note from testing: screen readers need a short hidden summary. include `id=peek-summary-{rowId}` and wire `aria-describedby` from the peek-toggle.
rachel (design): thanks — i'll revise frames and post links here. also adding a tiny retry state in the peek UI in case fetch fails.
dina (pm): perfect. i'll create the experiment ticket and share the rollout timeline. thanks team :sparkles:
